blocks.html: The installation of liquid-fueled stationary internal combustion engines and gas turbines, including combustion air, exhaust, fuel storage and piping, shall meet the requirements of NFPA 37 and Chapters 7, 8, and 13 of this code. Stationary engine generator assemblies shall meet the requirements of UL 2200.
